(section) s. 5.05 (7m) (voter ID information campaign)
(quote) Beginning on the effective date of this subsection.... [LRB inserts date], the board shall conduct a public informational campaign for the purpose of informing the electors of the voter identification requirements under ch. 6.

(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
